resources.string: Sign in to start. Your account keeps your name and what you share; your alarms stay on this phone.
Type your email above, then tap “Forgot your password?” again.
If there\'s an account with %1$s, you\'ll get a link to create a new password.
The password needs at least %1$d characters.
There\'s already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
This email already has a Calarmi account with another sign-in method (like Apple on an iPhone). Use Google or a different email.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
There\'s no Google account on this phone. Add one in the phone\'s Settings › Accounts, or use your email.
Signing in with Google isn\'t available on this phone. Use your email and a password.
This is how the people you share alarms and countdowns with see you. Your email is never shown to anyone.
This is how the people you share alarms and countdowns with see you.
Your alarms stay on this phone and keep ringing. To use Calarmi again, you\'ll need to sign in.

Your account and what you share are deleted: your shared alarms and countdowns stop being shared, and you leave what others shared with you and their trusted-people lists. The alarms on this phone stay. This can\'t be undone.
Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, you can also ask for it from the privacy policy page.
